name: TestOptim
description: Run AI QA test runs on your web app from your coding agent with TestOptim (https://testoptim.com), and read the bugs they find, with steps to reproduce.
author: TestOptim

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the QA projects this token can access. Use it to find the project id the other tools need.

tools.name: start_test_run
tools.description: Start a QA test run against a project. Pass changedAreas to re-test only the pages or flows you just changed; omit it for the full suite. Returns a run id - poll get_test_run for the outcome. Runs take minutes, so do not poll in a tight loop.

changedAreas.description: Run only the tests covering these pages or flows, e.g. ["/checkout", "/cart"]: the parts of the app you just changed. Omit to run the full suite.

tools.name: get_test_run
tools.description: Check a test run: whether it is still running, and how many issues it found.

tools.name: stop_test_run
tools.description: Stop a running test run. Use it when a run was started against the wrong project, or is no longer needed - every test case it would still execute is billed.

tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: List QA issues in a project as short summaries - id, title, severity, status. Pass testRunId for only what one run found, or filter by severity to triage. Call get_issue for the full detail of one issue.

projectId.description: The project to read issues from

severity.description: Only return issues of this severity

testRunId.description: Only return the issues this test run found

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Get one issue in full: description, steps to reproduce, expected vs actual behaviour, page URL and screenshot. Use after list_issues to dig into a specific issue.

tools.name: start_exploration
tools.description: Explore the project's app so TestOptim learns new or changed pages and flows. Use it after adding pages, before start_test_run; tests for what it finds are generated and approved in the TestOptim app. Spends the plan's page allowance and replaces an exploration already running. Returns an exploration id - poll get_exploration, which takes minutes.

projectId.description: The project whose app to explore

tools.name: get_exploration
tools.description: Check an exploration: its status, progress and, once it has ended, how many pages and flows it recorded. waiting_otp_ready or waiting_otp means the login needs a one-time code entered in the TestOptim app.
